subject: general
question:
What would be the word on the opposite side of 'Feb' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64052316d03c9d65c91ac161f61f8dbc627bbd1c4a6889dd8d2933297dbec56d.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b70d5abc64d9da12360bb8d4a026d88b4dd61218c8b54bcf355fcedd56ef7159.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

Mar → Apr

May → Feb

Jan → June

Therefore, 'May' is the opposite of 'Feb'.

Hence,** Option 4:** May is the correct answer.
